description: NgRx helps Angular apps organise shared state. Actions say what happened, reducers choose the next values, and selectors read them. Learn each part with a small reading counter before meeting effects and SignalStore. Use an Angular project with the matching major version of @ngrx/store. Effects and SignalStore examples also need @ngrx/effects or @ngrx/signals. Save linked snippets in the files named by their imports.
versionNote: Uses modern NgRx Store, standalone providers and SignalStore APIs; package majors must match Angular.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to create an action carrying amount 5
Learn to create a selector that doubles the reading count
Learn to name the action this effect listens for and the one it returns
learningObjectives: Learn to create an action carrying amount 5
Learn to create a selector that doubles the reading count
Learn to name the action this effect listens for and the one it returns
